newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Donaldson Co raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Donaldson Co raised.

text.p: -- Piper Jaffray said it upgraded Donaldson Co Inc to strong buy from buy.
-- expects Donaldson's shares to appreciate over the next 12 months to a range of $38 to $40 a share.
-- said Donaldson's second quarter results topped expectations. Donaldson posted second quarter earnings of $0.43 a share, up from $0.35 a share a year ago.
-- Piper raised the 1997 earnings estimate to $1.94 a share from $1.92 a share. Raised the 1998 earnings estimate to $2.23 a share from $2.20 a share.
-- expects Donaldson to meet or exceed earnings expectations through fiscal 1997.
-- Donaldson gained 1-1/4 to 32-3/4 in morning trading.
